items.title: AstraZeneca’s Oncology Engine Faces a Key Test After Camizestrant Miss
items.summary: AstraZeneca PLC (NYSE:AZN)’s breast cancer pill Etcamah (camizestrant) failed to meet the primary endpoint in the Phase III SERENA-4 trial, dealing a setback to one of the company’s key oncology growth opportunities. items.title: Is This LLY Stock Dip Big Enough To Be Worth Buying?
items.summary: Eli Lilly (LLY) trades near $1,120, about 13% below the high it set in August, and the question is whether to step in. The stock's record after sharp falls is clean but short. That record asks for the better part of a year and more pain before it pays. And this fall is not the kind of fall that record is built on.
